theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_ct_zero_scale_iterate
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ k, 0 < ss k) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto ss atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ ball x δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp S y (ss k) (hss k).ne') C → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp T (xs (φ k) + lams (φ k) • y) (lams (φ k) * ss k) (mul_pos (hlams (φ k)) (hss k)).ne') C) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (b y : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ k, 0 < ss k) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → b ∈ U → (∀ i, dist (cs i) z < r - ts i) → Tendsto ts atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto cs atTop (𝓝 b) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S → (∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ ball b δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → ‖y‖ < 1 → Tendsto ss atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp S y (ss k) (hss k).ne') C → ∃ (cs' : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts' : ℕ → ℝ) (hts' : ∀ i, 0 < ts' i), (∀ i, dist (cs' i) z < r - ts' i) ∧ Tendsto ts' atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto cs' atTop (𝓝 b) ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs' i) (ts' i) (hts' i).ne') C
